context: A retired exec advises on team building
purpose: Teach: 本田/石田/安田/川口/神田/大塚/野口/高木

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 本田くん、若い頃から器が大きかった。
lines.en: Honda had a big heart from the moment he was young.
lines.style: Quiet nostalgia, speaking from deep memory. Steady pace, eyes slightly distant. The weight of years of observation in each name. Warm but not sentimental.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 石田、安田、川口、神田、皆若い才能でして。
lines.en: Ishida, Yasuda, Kawaguchi, Kanda—all of them promising young talent.
lines.style: Precise listing, genuine respect in the tone. Slight pause between names, like counting through people he knows well. Measured, earnest. No flourish.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 大塚くんも、私が育てた一人だ。野口くんも。
lines.en: Otsuka is another one I helped develop. Noguchi as well.
lines.style: Gentle pride underneath. Slow delivery, as if tracing the shape of mentorship completed. Soft weight on 'I.' Not boastful—matter-of-fact about having contributed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 高木さんが新時代のAIを引っ張ってくれてます。
lines.en: Takagi-san has been leading us into this new era of AI.
lines.style: Conviction with respect. Lean forward slightly on the name. Direct eye contact. Not tentative—he has seen this unfold. Steady breath, clear ending.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 人を見抜く目、養い続けろ。
lines.en: Keep sharpening your eye for people. That skill never gets old.
lines.style: Final instruction, delivered gently but firmly. Slight slow-down on the core phrase. Not a warning—an inheritance. Voice trails into something almost paternal.
